name: dn-multi-ava-rdn-match-valid
description: permittedSubtrees directoryName contains a multi-AVA RDN (O=Example+OU=Engineering). The leaf subject's matching RDN has the same two AVAs in the same order, plus an additional CN RDN after the constrained prefix. The leaf is inside the subtree.
notes: An RDN is a SET OF AttributeTypeAndValue. RFC 5280 7.1 requires two RDNs to match when they have the same number of attributes and each attribute in one has a matching attribute in the other. Implementations that only support single-AVA RDNs may mis-handle this constraint.
